mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 2% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a 5-day negative S&P 500 forward return due to immediate market anticipation of tighter policy.
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative returns when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as strong hiring signals robust consumer demand.
failure_condition: In regimes with falling PAYEMS, no consistent positive 20-day returns (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in GDPC1 (goods orders) by at least 2% in the prior quarter is followed by a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as weak demand depresses corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: No significant negative returns when GDPC1 declines by <2% (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO (industrial production) exceeding 1% is accompanied by a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing output anticipates near-term supply constraints and inflationary pressure.
failure_condition: No positive returns when INDPRO declines by <1% (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (inflation) above 2.5% and 3% respectively over the prior month triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return via risk-off sentiment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 3% in the prior month
failure_condition: No significant negative returns when both proxies rise but S&P 500 outperforms (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE (unemployment) above 4% for three consecutive months predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as weak labor market signals contractionary policy expectations.
failure_condition: No negative returns when UNRATE remains ≤4% for 3 months (robustness check).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in HOUST (housing starts) and PAYEMS (jobs) above 1200 and 150000 respectively in the prior 2 months leads to a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via optimism about demand recovery.
failure_condition: No positive returns when either proxy is below threshold (multivariate Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a supply-side shock as indicated by INDPRO falling below 105 (monthly) while RSAFS (retail sales) remains flat for two months precedes a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return due to earnings compression.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 105 AND RSAFS same as prior month for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: No negative returns when both proxies show normal growth (p > 0.05).
